title: Bright Top Cabbage (Bright Top F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Bright Top cabbage is an F1 hybrid cabbage variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Bright Top cabbage is an F1 hybrid cabbage variety, also sold or known as Bright Top F1 or Known You Bright Top cabbage. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Known You Seed (sold in Philippine farm shops).

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Bright Top cabbage is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Bright Top F1 or Known You Bright Top cabbage, this is the same cabbage. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [cabbage variety finder](/crop-varieties/cabbage), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).

Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: harvest about 105 days after sowing. No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit cabbage fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [black rot of cabbage](/diseases/black-rot), [cabbage webworm](/pests/cabbage-webworm), [clubroot](/diseases/clubroot), [diamondback moth](/pests/diamondback-moth). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** Harvest about 105 days after sowing.
**Fruit:** Head: about 2.5 kg, 16 cm high and 21 cm across.

blocks.text: These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual cabbage on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Bright Top cabbage

Most repolyo comes from the highlands, where it heads well. Lowland growers need a heat tolerant hybrid and a cool month. Pick a firm head that keeps on the trip to market. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.

items.q: Is Bright Top F1 the same as Bright Top?
items.a: Yes. Bright Top F1 is another name for Bright Top. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Bright Top?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
